name: MLcon Berlin 2026
description: Machine learning and generative AI conference for developers, with bootcamps
note: Hybrid conference + workshops, English/German (not stated); 10% team discount until start
details: Bootcamps on 16-17 November, workshop days 17 and 20 November, conference and expo on 18-19 November. Tracks cover generative AI and agents, LLMOps, advanced RAG, AI developer tools and AI platform engineering. Cheapest ticket is a workshop day from 659 EUR, the 2-day conference pass from 1,079 EUR (VAT incl., with team discount). Remote tickets give livestream, live Q&A and recordings. Part of AI Native Week; talk language not stated on the page.
